case.summary: Real-time monitoring flagged transaction 3549837 ($299.94 online purchase on 2016-12-16 23:40:18) with an initial model score of 0.99. Graph analysis confirmed a calibrated fraud probability of 0.83, supported by the device profile's three prior uses on this card and the card's history of 12 confirmed fraud cases. When the cardholder denied making the transaction and confirmed they still possess the physical card, fraud probability rose to 0.94. Per Policy R2, the card is blocked and a case is created for internal record; exposure of $299.94 remains below the $1,000 reporting threshold and no shared devices or connected cards are involved, so regulatory filing is not required.
